_about: The flow ontology as an OTO unit, ported from the flow: terms of ontology/ontology.ttl by tools/flow_port.py: how work is executed. Steps with typed executors, gated by checks, connected by guarded transitions, exchanging artifacts; tests derived from checks, transitions and invariants. Every term keeps its IRI under https://cynergis.ai/ont/flow#. A relation is {domain, range, inverse, definition}. Use A|B for a union.
_summary: Executable process graphs: steps with typed executors (script, OCR, Claude, human, terminal), gated by checks against metrics and parameters, connected by guarded transitions with effects, exchanging artifacts with fields; invariants and the tests derived from them. The briefs an agent reads before implementing or testing a step, building the engine, or changing a parameter or an artifact.
name: Flow

Artifact.definition: A file or folder exchanged between steps, with a path, format and field structure.
Artifact.label: Artifact

Check.definition: A deterministic validation run after a step; a blocking failure sets the step's outcome.
Check.label: Check

ClaudeStep.definition: Claude with a versioned prompt and a required output schema; cached by input hash; never routes.
ClaudeStep.label: Claude step

DeterministicStep.definition: A script: same inputs, same outputs.
DeterministicStep.label: Deterministic step

Effect.definition: A state mutation applied when a transition is taken (set, increment, reset, append…).
Effect.label: Effect

Flow.definition: A versioned process graph with entrypoints, phases, steps and transitions.
Flow.label: Flow

HumanStep.definition: A person records a decision; the flow pauses until it exists.
HumanStep.label: Human step

Implementation.definition: The script that executes a step.
Implementation.label: Implementation

Invariant.definition: A statement that must always hold; enforced by one or more checks.
Invariant.label: Invariant

Metric.definition: A named measurement a step records in run state and checks compare against parameters.
Metric.label: Metric

OcrStep.definition: An OCR engine run; output carries per-word confidence.
OcrStep.label: OCR step

Outcome.definition: A named result of a step (pass, fail, approve, …); the only thing transitions branch on.
Outcome.label: Outcome

Phase.definition: A named group of steps run together (e.g. template build, production run).
Phase.label: Phase

Step.definition: A unit of work with declared inputs, outputs, checks and outcomes.
Step.label: Step

TestObligation.definition: A test that must exist before a step's implementation is accepted; derived mechanically from the graph.
TestObligation.label: Test obligation

Transition.definition: A directed edge from a step, taken on an outcome when its guard holds; may apply effects to run state.
Transition.label: Transition

ArtifactField.definition: A named path inside a structured artifact (e.g. pages[].regions[].bbox).
ArtifactField.label: Field

ConfigParameter.definition: A configuration value (threshold, limit, seed) owned by config, never by steps.
ConfigParameter.label: Parameter

comparedTo.definition: The configuration value the check compares its metrics against; changing it changes what passes.

enforcedBy.definition: A check that fails when the invariant is broken.

entrypoint.definition: The step a run of the phase starts at.

forStep.definition: The step whose implementation must pass the test.

hasCheck.definition: A validation run after the step's action. The first failed blocking check sets the step's outcome.

hasEffect.definition: A change to run state applied when the transition is taken; effects apply in order.

hasOutcome.definition: A result the step can end with. Every outcome needs at least one transition.

implementedBy.definition: The script that executes the step.

inPhase.definition: The phase the step belongs to (template build, production run).

measures.definition: A metric the check's expression reads. The step must record it (flow:records).

onFail.definition: The outcome the step takes when this check fails and is blocking.

onOutcome.definition: The outcome of the source step on which the transition is considered.

reads.definition: An artifact the step needs as input; the step is blocked when it is missing.

readsOptional.definition: An artifact the step uses when it is present and runs without when it is absent.

records.definition: A measurement the step writes to run state, for its checks and for transition guards.

tests.definition: What the required test exercises: a check (pass and fail case), a transition (route), or an invariant (property).

to.definition: The step the transition goes to.

usesParameter.definition: A configuration value the step's action, or the transition's guard, depends on.

writes.definition: An artifact the step produces as output.

hasArtifactField.definition: A named path the artifact's content must contain. A JSON artifact with no fields is under-specified: an agent must not guess its structure.

outputOf.definition: The step that creates the artifact.

dependsOn.label: depends on
dependsOn.definition: A configuration parameter the step's behaviour depends on: compared to by one of its checks, read by a guard of one of its transitions, or used by its action. Derived; never stated.

affectedBy.label: affected by
affectedBy.definition: What a change of the parameter reaches: the check compared to it, the transition whose guard reads it, the step whose action uses it, the test of a check compared to it. Derived; never stated.

requiresTest.label: requires a test of
requiresTest.definition: What a test of the step's implementation must exercise before the implementation is accepted: each of its checks (a pass and a fail case), each transition from it (a route), each invariant its checks enforce (a property). Derived; never stated. A TestObligation node is the same fact materialised, with an id code can cite.

readBy.label: read by
readBy.definition: A step that reads the artifact, required or optional. Derived from reads and readsOptional, so one question covers both.

blocking.definition: Whether a failure of the check stops the step: 'true', 'false', or an expression over run state that decides.

checkId.definition: Identifier of the check, unique in its step (fidelity, overflow).

checkKind.definition: How the check is evaluated: metric (a comparison over recorded metrics) | script | json_schema | file_exists.

expression.definition: What the check evaluates: a comparison over metrics and config, a script to run, a schema, or a path that must exist.

command.definition: The command line that runs the step, for steps executed by a script.

foreach.definition: The collection in run state the step runs once per item of (the documents of a batch, the stress cases).
foreach.label: for each

isImplemented.definition: Whether the flow definition marks the step's action as implemented.

retryMax.definition: How many times the step is re-run on a retryable outcome before that outcome stands.
retryMax.label: retry maximum

stepId.definition: Identifier of the step, unique in its flow (B10_verify). Transitions, run state, briefs and code citations refer to a step by it.

usesOcr.definition: True when the step runs an OCR engine as part of its work.
usesOcr.label: uses OCR

promptRef.definition: The prompt file the Claude step is invoked with.
promptRef.label: prompt reference

reviewPage.definition: The page shown to the person who must decide.

decisionOption.definition: A decision the person may record; each becomes an outcome of the step.

requiredField.definition: A field the recorded decision must carry (reviewer, comment…) before the flow continues.

exists.definition: Whether the script was found on disk when the graph was built.

format.definition: The file format of the artifact (json, png, pdf, folder…).

optional.definition: True when the artifact need not exist for the flow to proceed.

carries.label: carries
carries.definition: The domain concepts this artifact holds, by class name: what the file is about, so a step's inputs and outputs are read as domain things, not paths.

guard.definition: A condition over run state and config that must hold for the transition to be taken; absent means always.

priority.definition: Order in which the transitions for one step and outcome are tried: ascending, and the first whose guard holds is taken.

toDynamic.definition: A target read from run state when the transition is taken, e.g. $state.context.resume_node; used in place of flow:to.
toDynamic.label: to (dynamic)

metricName.definition: Name of the metric as it appears in run state under the step.

obligationKind.definition: The kind of test required: pass_case | fail_case | route | property.

op.definition: The kind of change: set | set_from | increment | reset | append | reactivate_items | exclude_failed_items.
op.label: operation

statePath.definition: The path in run state the effect changes.

outcomeName.definition: Name of the outcome (pass, fail, approve, reject…); the only thing transitions branch on.

promptVersion.definition: Version of the prompt; part of the cache key, so a new version invalidates cached outputs.

writesOnly.definition: A path the Claude step may write to; anything written outside the listed paths fails the scope check.

statement.definition: The invariant, stated in one sentence.

concerns.label: concerns
concerns.definition: The domain concepts the invariant constrains, by class name.

fieldPath.definition: The path of the field inside the artifact (pages[].regions[].bbox).

paramName.definition: Name of the configuration value, as its path in the flow's config (claude.model, ssim_region_min_vector).
paramName.label: parameter name
